reviewer: codex-ou-scenes; independent from root image generator
method: view_image inspection of all seven final revisions, following the separately preserved eleven-source/eleven-output review; both named fan-master images were also visually rechecked.

user_acceptance_scope.quote: 保留目前華麗古裝與細緻人物風格
user_acceptance_scope.interpretation: Only the shared art-style direction is accepted; this does not accept individual image details.

scope_limit: PASS means the specified local correction is visually satisfactory at the provided image scale. It is not pixel equality, final costume/geometry lock, owner acceptance, normal-look import or animation verification.
history: fan-independent-review.json and fan-independent-review.md remain unchanged as the earlier eleven-image review. All PNG revisions and raw prompts remain preserved.
master_policy: Only the two named detail/prop sheets may define the fan's white-jade guards, white folded paper, closed state and absence of attached cord/chain/jade/tassel. Blue ornaments belong to the waist. The seven character/ensemble/action images do not override those structural references; restricted images cannot be used to derive fan or attachment topology.

fan_structure_masters.observation: 左上三個扇視圖與左下持扇均為白玉、白紙、閉合；扇尾無附掛線鏈／玉／穗。右下藍色腰飾接腰扣，保持與扇分離。
獨立扇與扇尾近圖均無藍玉、繩或穗；保留白玉扇骨、白紙與小鉸釘。此處只核扇結構，不把念珠／錢板順帶宣稱為新核准。

media.observation: 右拳下額外短珠鏈／穗已消失。白玉合扇保持同一右手握姿，兩組中央藍色腰掛物各自可見腰帶接點；臉、冠羽、髮形、白銀鶴紋和全身構圖未見新增硬錯。
media.limit: 通過本次局部去附件修正；精確扇結構仍以指定細節／道具板為準。

media.observation: 合扇為白色且閉合；拳下仍有細線連一顆灰藍珠及短穗。上端在手與衣層後消失，畫面不能可靠區分接腰後被手遮住，或接於扇尾；不能寫成已確認無扇墜。右側較長腰掛物仍清楚，臉、冠羽、側身姿勢與持扇手身份未見新增硬錯。
media.limit: 僅供身份、側面髮衣輪廓／服裝參照，禁止作扇附件或腰掛接點母版；不把遮擋歧義宣判為角色身份失敗。

media.limit: 僅供身份、服裝與該視角輪廓參照；精確扇尾／附件接點禁用此圖作母版。此限制源於低對比殘影歧義，並非新增身份或手部硬錯。
